name: markdown
title: Markdown Viewer & Editor
description: Read-only markdown renderer (Markdown) and rich markdown editor with toolbar and change tracking (EditableMarkdown), built on tiptap. Use for displaying stored markdown content and for editing long-form rich text persisted as markdown.
docs: Read-only: import { Markdown } from '@/components/ui/markdown' and pass value. Editable: import { EditableMarkdown } from '@/components/ui/editable-markdown' with defaultValue + onChange(markdown). Typography styles come from @tailwindcss/typography (installed with this item).

changelog.description: Brings the app's copy up to date and adds its version line.
